note: Scorecard vectors: each is a weighted aggregate of rule families + the checks that measure them. DNA vector_targets use the same ids. Adopted from SiteRater RATING.md (2026-11-19).
weights_note: weights normalised to 1.0; overall = weighted mean of vectors

ease_of_use.measure: tap targets, nav link count, form presence, duplicate nav, sticky chrome

clarity.measure: 5-s elements present, h1+subhead reading level, heading grammar

layout.measure: container width vs viewport, dead regions, chrome position, PS.1-PS.6

typography.measure: font stack, size ramp, body >=16px and lh >=1.5, heading misuse

colour.measure: role map, pairwise contrast both modes, accent area

rhythm.measure: inter-section gap distribution, density-tier variance, trapped whitespace

imagery.measure: img count/alt/srcset/lazy/dims, icon family, oversized images

trust.measure: logo wall, testimonials, LocalBusiness schema, review badges

conversion.measure: CTA cadence <=2 viewports, above-fold elements, terminal CTA, competing primaries

seo.measure: title length/repeat, h1 count, heading vector order, link-farm density

mobile.measure: hscroll at 360/768, tap targets, collapse, doc-height budget

speed.measure: static budgets: JS weight, image dims/format/lazy/fetchpriority, self-hosted fonts with swap+preload, no render-blocking third party (Lighthouse = operator post-build check, not a gate)

a11y.measure: axe-core, alt coverage, landmarks, link names, focus-visible

overall.measure: weighted mean of every vector above
